policy: Exact public/ad-hoc tariff evidence only. Subscription, roaming, historical and sampled station values are not generalized beyond their proven scope.

cpos.operator: REWAG Regensburger Energie- und Wasserversorgung AG & Co KG

findings.publicNetwork: REWAG states it manages more than 1,000 charging points, about 590 of them public in the region.
findings.directPayment: Official direct payment via PayPal requires no specific charging card: scan the QR code and enter payment data online.
findings.directAC: Normal charging stations up to 49 kW: 0.5000 EUR/kWh. Where a blocking fee applies: 0.0200 EUR/min between 09:00 and 19:00 from the 121st minute of standing time.
findings.directDC: Fast charging stations from 50 kW: 0.5500 EUR/kWh. Where a blocking fee applies: 0.1000 EUR/min from the 61st minute of standing time.
findings.stationSpecificBlocking: REWAG explicitly states that the blocking fee is charged only at various stations in the Regensburg city area and that affected locations are marked in the station descriptions.

cpos.reason: Energy and applicable blocking rates are exact and official, but the blocking-fee applicability flag remains station-specific. Exact total pricing is not complete until the affected station/EVSE set is mapped exhaustively.
cpos.neededToComplete: Harvest the official REWAG station list/description flags and map every represented REWAG EVSE to blocking-fee applicable or not-applicable, preserving the <=49 kW and >=50 kW bands.

findings.publicNetwork: Mainova stated on 2026-05-11 that it operates around 750 charging points and is a major charging-infrastructure provider in Hesse.
findings.currentDigitalAccess: Mainova directs public charging users to the Shell Recharge app; the 2026 Mainova/Shell partnership states that Mainova customers receive 20% off the current kWh price at Mainova stations when charging through the Shell app.
findings.pricingScope: The official partnership announcement refers to the current kWh price but does not publish a numeric network-wide direct/ad-hoc tariff or prove that one price applies to every Mainova station/EVSE.

cpos.reason: Current charging infrastructure and Shell-mediated pricing are official, but no exact numeric station/EVSE direct tariff matrix is exposed in the audited Mainova pages. A discount statement cannot be inverted into an underlying price.
cpos.neededToComplete: Resolve Shell Recharge/Mainova station identifiers against Mainova EVSEs and capture the exact current direct price and any time/blocking/parking component per station from a public checkout or official station feed.

findings.historicalOfficialTariff: An official Stadtwerke Baden-Baden price sheet published for validity from 2023-02-01 documents ad-hoc AC at 1.50 EUR start + 0.63 EUR/kWh + 0.05 EUR/min from minute 61, and ad-hoc DC at 1.50 EUR start + 0.77 EUR/kWh + 0.05 EUR/min from minute 1.
findings.freshness: No newer official electromobility price sheet establishing those values as current in September 2026 was found in the audited public source surface.

cpos.reason: The only exact official ad-hoc matrix found is explicitly old. It is retained as historical discovery evidence but must not be used as a current 2026 tariff.
cpos.neededToComplete: Locate a current 2026 Stadtwerke Baden-Baden/e-laden tariff sheet, station QR checkout or AFIR/Mobilithek tariff publication and map the exact current values to represented stations/EVSEs.
